name: SDN Host Node Status
description: Host node_status_read connector (typed contracts 1.0; M1 node-status flow, GET /api/v1/node/status). Method "status" takes ONE $APR (SDS API Request: the routing decision from foundation/http-route route_node_status) on "decision". When ROUTE is "status" and STATUS is 0 it reads node_status_read.status (SDS $PIV hostcall: no params; "result" NodeStatusReport, list "bandwidth_history" NodeBandwidthSample), node.peerId (raw "value") and clock.now (TimeValue), and emits ONE $NHS (SDS Node Health Status: NODE_ID, GENERATED_AT_MS, STARTED_AT_MS, UPTIME_S, SERVICE_STATE/SERVICE_MODE, store and disk figures, HAS_NETWORK with totals, rates and THROUGHPUT_HISTORY) on "status", plus the input $APR verbatim on "decision". A decision refused upstream (STATUS set, e.g. 405) passes through untouched with NO hostcall and no body; a ROUTE this method does not own is answered STATUS 404 "no-route". A node_status_read.status failure answers the $APR with STATUS 503 "status-unavailable" and the host message, no body. GENERATED_AT_MS is 0 when the host clock is unavailable (the snapshot is still served). Not measured by the host and so absent: SOFTWARE_VERSION, compute figures (HAS_COMPUTE false), CONNECTION_COUNT, NOTES. No JSON between modules: foundation/http-respond renders the $NHS. Capabilities: node_status_read (Go node: the op prefix) and clock (built-in on the Go node; capability-gated on the SDK NodeHost/BrowserHost).

externalInterfaces.description: Policy-mediated read-only host node-status snapshot as SDS $PIV hostcalls (node_status_read.status -> NodeStatusReport + list bandwidth_history); node.peerId (ungated) names the node.

acceptedTypeSets.description: $APR from foundation/http-route route_node_status: ROUTE "status" (GET/HEAD) or STATUS 405 for any other method.

inputPorts.description: One routing decision per HTTP exchange.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The input $APR verbatim when served or refused upstream; a copy with STATUS 404 "no-route" (route not owned) or 503 "status-unavailable" (host failure).
$NHS (SDS Node Health Status) built from NodeStatusReport + bandwidth_history, NODE_ID from node.peerId, GENERATED_AT_MS from clock.now.

outputPorts.description: The status snapshot; absent when the decision is refused or the host read failed.

methods.description: Reads the node status through node_status_read.status (typed: SDS $PIV) when the $APR routes "status", and emits the $NHS snapshot beside the decision. BATCHING: the "decision" port is single-stream BY CONTRACT and ENFORCED IN CODE: the compiled flow runtime drains a node queue port-blind (maxStreams is declarative only), so a surplus frame is refused with error code "batched-input-frames" naming the port and the count rather than silently discarded (graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames).

sequentialJustification.detail: Each invocation makes one node_status_read hostcall and answers it on the calling thread; the host runs independent invocations in parallel and this module creates no threads.
